senses.gloss: (for ऋषभ) The second note of the Indian Gamut.

I. 6 P. (रियति, रीण) To go, move. --II. 5 P. (रिणोति) To hurt. --III. 9 U. (रिणाति-ते) 
__1 To drive out, expel. 
__2 Ved. To separate. 
__3 To emit. 
__4 To give, grant. 
__5 To go, move. 
__6 To hurt.

I. 4 Ā. (रीयते) To trickle, drip, distil, ooze, flow. --II. 9 [[U.]] (रिणाति, रिणीते, रीण; caus. रेपयति-ते) 
__1 To go, move. 
__2 To hurt, injure, kill. 
__3 To howl.
